abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HA Alarm Clock configuration is allowed.

data_description.hidden_media_players: Hide selected players from the alarm and reminder card pickers. Service calls and manual entity entry are unaffected.
data_description.restrict_non_admin_ownership: When enabled, non-admin users only see their own alarms and reminders in the companion cards and cannot change ownership there. Services and Home Assistant state access are unaffected.

error.default_media_player_hidden: The default media player cannot also be hidden.
